name: ado
description: Azure DevOps Server: work items, repositories, pull requests and pipelines

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: Azure DevOps Server root, e.g. https://ado.imagile.dev (keep any /tfs prefix)

connection.name: collection
connection.description: Default collection, when --collection isn't given

connection.name: project
connection.description: Default team project, when --project isn't given

connection.name: repo
connection.description: Default git repository, when --repo isn't given

connection.name: fieldAliases
connection.description: Work item field aliases, friendly name to reference name (e.g. {"storypoints": "Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.StoryPoints"})

connection.name: discoveredFields
connection.description: Work item fields recorded by an earlier discovery; kept, not read

connection.name: discoveredTypes
connection.description: Work item types recorded by an earlier discovery; kept, not read

connection.name: pat
connection.description: Personal access token

name: bitbucket
description: Bitbucket Data Center: repositories, pull requests, comments, reviewers and build statuses

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: Bitbucket server root, e.g. https://bitbucket.imagile.dev

connection.name: project
connection.description: Default project key

connection.name: repo
connection.description: Default repository slug

connection.name: targetBranch
connection.description: Default target branch for pr create (main when unset)

connection.name: pat
connection.description: HTTP access token

name: github
description: GitHub and GitHub Enterprise Server: pull requests, reviews, comments, checks, labels, assignees, issues and projects

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: REST API root: https://api.github.com, or https://ghe.imagile.dev/api/v3 for Enterprise Server

connection.name: owner
connection.description: Default owner (user or org)

connection.name: repo
connection.description: Default repository name

connection.name: targetBranch
connection.description: Default base branch for pr create (main when unset)

connection.name: token
connection.description: Fine-grained personal access token

name: jenkins
description: Jenkins: jobs, builds, console logs and the build queue

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: Jenkins server root, e.g. https://jenkins.imagile.dev

connection.name: username
connection.description: Jenkins user name the API token belongs to

connection.name: instance
connection.description: The name --instance selects this connection by, when it isn't the connection's own name

connection.name: apiToken
connection.description: Jenkins API token

name: jira
description: Jira Data Center: issues, search, transitions, comments, worklogs, attachments, custom fields, boards and sprints

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: Jira server root, e.g. https://jira.imagile.dev

connection.name: customFields
connection.description: Custom fields addressable by friendly name

connection.name: project
connection.description: Default project key for issue create

connection.name: issueType
connection.description: Default issue type for issue create (Task when unset)

connection.name: priority
connection.description: Default priority for issue create

connection.name: apiToken
connection.description: Personal access token

name: openshift
description: OpenShift and Kubernetes: pods, deployments, events, logs and resource usage

connection.name: baseUrl
connection.description: API server URL, e.g. https://openshift.imagile.dev

connection.name: env
connection.description: Environment name that --env selects this cluster by, e.g. prod

connection.name: instance
connection.description: Cluster instance name within the environment that --instance selects this cluster by, e.g. east

connection.name: token
connection.description: Bearer token, typically a service account token
